spec.name: PGLib IEEE 14-bus — loss of the main unit gen-1 (deliberate load shedding)
spec.description: Generator gen-1 (bus-1, 340 MW, the cheapest and largest unit) is forced out. The remaining dispatchable capacity (gen-2, 59 MW) cannot cover the 259 MW load, so the run deliberately demonstrates load shedding at VOLL (expected unserved energy = 259 - 59 = 200 MWh).
assumptions: Synchronous condensers (carrier SYNC) have zero active-power capacity in the dataset
